verifyOwnership.title: Haryana Jamabandi Record Lookup
verifyOwnership.description: Use this record lookup to view a Haryana Jamabandi entry by tehsil, village, and khasra number. It does not verify legal title, possession, or ownership.
verifyOwnership.important: Important: Solve the CAPTCHA yourself. This lookup does not independently verify legal title, possession, or ownership. Confirm the current record with the official service and seek legal advice before a purchase.
verifyOwnership.notFound: No land record found for the given Tehsil, Village, and Khasra Number.
verifyOwnership.dataSourced: When available, lookup data is returned by the Haryana Jamabandi service. Check the current record directly before making a decision.

aboutJamabandi.title: Limits of this lookup
aboutJamabandi.description: The tool requests a Jamabandi record using tehsil, village, and khasra number. Returned fields may include recorded names, area, mutation status, and encumbrance details. It does not independently verify legal title, title deeds, possession, disputes, or ownership.
tips: Use the returned record as one reference, not proof of title.
Check the current record directly with the official service.
Confirm that the record matches the land parcel and supporting documents.
Ask a qualified lawyer to review title and encumbrance questions.
